page.title: Recall trace
page.description: Trace a unit upstream to its mother and downstream through everything derived from it, with where each unit is now, who holds it and which shipments carried it.
page.notFoundBody: Check the number, or search by name.
page.startBody: Search for the unit involved in the recall. The trace lists its mother line, every unit derived from it, where they are, and which organizations received them.
page.noMatchBody: No unit name contains “{q}”. Try a shorter part of the name.

results.caption: Units matching the search

page.truncatedBody: Only the first {count} derived units are listed. Trace one of the listed units to follow the rest.

lineage.title: Lineage
lineage.hint: The mother line comes first, then the traced unit, then everything derived from it, each unit followed by its own offspring.
